title: Skin Care for Guwahati Weather: A Light Routine for a Long Monsoon and Dry Winter
ex: Humid for most of the year, a long early monsoon and a dry, dusty winter: a simple skin care routine for people living in Guwahati.
rt: Skin Care for Guwahati Weather: Monsoon Routine | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care for Guwahati weather: light layers for humid months, monsoon and flood-water hygiene, sunscreen on rainy days, dry dusty winter care, kept simple.
quick: Guwahati is warm and humid from spring to autumn, with a long, early monsoon, and dry and dusty in winter. A gentle face wash, a thin moisturiser, broad-spectrum sunscreen every morning and less night cream in the rainy months, more in winter, suit most people.
facts: Guwahati has a humid subtropical climate
The monsoon starts early and is long and heavy
November to February is cooler, drier and dusty
Pre-monsoon storms are common in spring
